newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Nanjing Posts to list 100 mln B shares on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Nanjing Posts to list 100 mln B shares on Thursday.

text.p: China's Nanjing Posts & Telecommunications Equipment Co Ltd will on Thursday list 100 million B shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, the company said on Tuesday.

The company last month issued foreign currency B shares at HK$2.43 per share, giving a price/earnings ratio of 8.87 times on a fully diluted basis, Nanjing Posts said in a listing announcement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The P/E ratio was calculated according to forecast after-tax profits for 1996 of more than 51.34 million yuan under international accounting standards, it said.
The company is expecting net profits to rise to 56 million yuan in 1997, a Nanjing Posts official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The company will use the proceeds from the issue to develop telecommunications equipment and improve technology, the company said in a B share offer prospectus.
Nanjing Posts, based in the eastern province of Jiangsu, has selected China Southern Securities as the listing sponsor and ABN-Amro as the international consultant.
After the offer, the company's total outstanding shares will number 215 million, composed of 115 million institutional shares and 100 million B shares, Nanjing Posts said in the listing announcement.
Nanjing Posts is among 33 firms selected by the China Securities Regulatory Commission to list B shares.
